items.information:
**[Galo]**
Enlist'ous **pour de ren** si qe v'étes un **nouvè coursou** ou ben un [**souétou de l'AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Aoterment d'aotr l'enlistement coûte 5 nuros.
Merci de **ben lire les condicions d'enlistement, la [Faire ao qhessions](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) e les [ghides d'espliqes de l'AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. 
Sonjéz etout d'ergarder den l'ongllet [Programe](#competition-schedule).

---
**[Brezhoneg]**
**Digoust** eo an enskrivadur evit ar **genstriverien nevez** hag [**izili an AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). A-hend-all e koust an enskrivadur 5€.
Mar plij, **lennit aketus ar c'hondisionoù evit lakaat e anv, an [FAG](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) ha [teulioù kennel an AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. 
Taolit ur sell d'an ivinell [Steuñvad](#competition-schedule) ivez.

---
**[Français]**
L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€.
Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. 
Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). 

----
**[English]**
Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€.
Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**.
Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab. 

---
**[Esperanto]**
Registriĝi estas **senpaga** por la **novaj konkursantoj** kaj [**AFS-membroj**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), ne gravas kia civitaneco vi havas aŭ kie vi loĝas. Alie, registriĝi kostas 5 eŭroj.
Bonvolu legi la **registriĝajn kondiĉojn, la [oftajn demandojn](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) kaj la [AFS-lernilojn](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) zorgeme**.
Legu ankaŭ la langeton [Horplano](#competition-schedule).

items.name: Athens Never Ending Summer A 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA5MjQ3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e23709c18c700fad635bbe810f90aa3643ebb9e6/516845675_30447345858214173_5310523430714211690_n.jpg)

**Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Α μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. 
Ο 3x3 και ο 2x2 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα Pyraminx ή 4x4 επιθυμείτε.

Ο πρώτος διαγωνισμός μετά το ατελείωτο ελληνικό καλοκαίρι! Ελάτε να περάσουμε όμορφα για ακόμα μία φορά στον γνωστό πλέον χώρο του Rubicon. Σας περιμένουμε στο **Athens Never Ending Summer 2025 - A.**

Αγωνίσματα Α' διαγωνισμού:
* 3x3
* 2x2
* Pyraminx

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI)

**Note:** This competition is part A of a series of two competitions. You can participate in **only one of the two**. 
3x3 and 2x2 is in both contests so choose carefully which day or which of Pyraminx or 4x4 you prefer.

The first competition after the endless Greek summer! Come and join us once again for a great time at the now well-known venue, Rubicon. We’re looking forward to seeing you at **Athens Never Ending Summer 2025 - A.**

Competition Α events:
* 3x3
* 2x2
* Pyraminx

Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information.

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information:
La calurosa ciudad de Lerdo de Tejada les da la bienvenida su primera competencia oficial donde no importa si eres principiante o veterano, todos tienen cabida y oportunidad de ganar.

El auditorio del  teatro municipal está listo para recibirles a todos en sus instalaciones equipadas de aire acondcionado para que disfruten al máximo de esta competencia.


Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la WCA. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE2MDMxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fc944bdaf91972d6f8ab758dc8178c0971758464/Logov1.png)

The warm Lerdo de Tejada town invites you to its first official cubing competition. It doesn't matter if you are a beginner or an expert; everybody is welcome. 

The local theatre auditorium is ready to welcome all of you to its AC-equipped installations so you can enjoy most of this two-day competition.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 170kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å være med.

---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Sandnes Open 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 170 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition.

items.name: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu IV 2025
items.information:
Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju.

---

Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.
